value.description: A frozen 6-2 on paper can't show a libero swap, a back-row attack or a setter dump. Pulse Tactical can.
points: Draw all six rotations with real position numbers, from serve receive to transition
Show setter releases, libero swaps and attack combinations, not just a static line-up
Animate the sequence so every approach, set and block assignment is clear before serve
